purpose: Measurement plans an experiment can carry. Every field is declared pre-result and is independent of the held-out validation formulation and its outcome.
declared_failure_mode: viscosity growth during prolonged 120 C melt residence (thermal-hold drift)

measurements.name: matched-window 120 C thermal hold
measurements.protocol: Hold the melt at 120 C. Record viscosity at 15, 30, 45 and 60 min. Report the 15-60 min matched-window relative change. Run at least two independent repeats.
measurements.interpretability_basis: direct matched-window observation; no model fit, no extrapolation and no imputation is required to obtain the primary observable
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: declared pre-result resolution of the matched-window drift estimate under the stated repeat protocol; hypothesis predictions closer than this are not treated as separable

measurements.name: 80-130 C temperature sweep
measurements.primary_observable: apparent temperature-response descriptor E_eta from ln(eta) versus 1/T
measurements.protocol: Measure viscosity from 80 to 130 C in 10 C increments on a freshly prepared sample and regress ln(eta) against 1/T.
measurements.interpretability_basis: the observable is a regression slope rather than a directly read value, so it inherits fit assumptions
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: measured local coefficient of variation of E_eta across six chemistry-audited realizations; a predicted shape change smaller than the observed spread is not separable

measurements.name: one-point state calibration check
measurements.primary_observable: multiplicative reconstruction error of the 120-130 C response from a single 110 C anchor
measurements.protocol: Measure viscosity at 110 C only, locate the realization on the shared local thermal response, then verify the predicted 120 and 130 C values against direct measurement.
measurements.interpretability_basis: requires the previously fitted shared thermal shape, so the observable is conditional on that model holding in the modified chemistry
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: pooled multiplicative RMSE of 1.088x measured in the strict formulation-and-temperature holdout

measurements.name: repeatability / state-control experiment
measurements.primary_observable: between-preparation spread of the realized viscosity-scale coordinate a_fr at matched temperature
measurements.protocol: Prepare the same nominal composition three times under a controlled and fully recorded process history, then measure the 80-130 C sweep for each preparation.
measurements.interpretability_basis: directly observed spread, though it answers a question about process control rather than about formulation mechanism
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: the measured E2 realization spread of 2.80-3.57x sets the scale a state-control experiment must beat to be informative
